headlines: 兩電料調高明年電費並向基層提供補貼 (Power utilities set to raise 2027 electricity tariffs amid subsidies for underprivileged)
執法部門瓦解涉及樓宇維修工程的圍標集團 (Joint task force busts major bid-rigging syndicate in building maintenance)
國際刑警大會下週在港舉行實施特別交通及禁飛安排 (Stringent traffic curbs and citywide no-fly zone imposed for Interpol General Assembly)
輝達晶片涉外洩案續受美方審視及各界關注 (Nvidia faces scrutiny over executive conduct and chip sales compliance)
達美航空航機重力計算系統故障致千班航班延誤 (Delta flights delayed following weight calculation system outage)
聯合國氣候大會未達核心協議引發各界失望 (COP climate talks conclude without overarching deal on fossil fuels)
蔡天鳳碎屍案被告繼續作供披露關係爭議 (Abby Choi murder trial continues as ex-husband Alex Kwong testifies)
神舟二十四號將迎巴基斯坦太空人載人合作創新猷 (Shenzhou 24 mission to make history with Pakistan's first astronaut)

items.en_ex: Power companies announced upcoming electricity tariff adjustments to reflect fluctuating generation costs.
items.zh_ex: 電力公司公布了即將進行的電費調整，以反映波動作響的發電成本。

items.en_ex: Economists predict there will likely be another sharp tariff hike by utility suppliers.
items.zh_ex: 經濟學家預測公用事業供應商很可能會再次大幅調高收費。

items.en_ex: Basic electricity rates dropped slightly year-on-year before recent geopolitical tensions escalated.
items.zh_ex: 在近期地緣政治緊張局勢升溫前，基本電費與去年同期相比略有下降。

items.en_ex: When factoring in fuel costs, power suppliers experienced a dramatic rise in expenditure.
items.zh_ex: 若將燃料成本計入在內，供電機構的開支出現了顯著上升。

items.en_ex: Vital commercial waterways being blockaded disrupted international maritime trade and raised shipping tariffs.
items.zh_ex: 關鍵商業航道遭封鎖打亂了國際海運貿易，並推高了運輸費用。

items.en_ex: Lawmakers demanded that private utilities become more transparent regarding their operational accounting methods.
items.zh_ex: 議員們要求私營公用事業公司對其營運核算方式更加公開透明。

items.en_ex: Targeted government subsidies are urgently needed to alleviate the financial burden on vulnerable families.
items.zh_ex: 急需具針對性的政府補貼，以減輕弱勢家庭的財務負擔。

items.en_ex: The enterprise promised to allocate millions of dollars to assist low-income tenants.
items.zh_ex: 該企業承諾撥出數百萬元以資助低收入租戶。

items.en_ex: Financial assistance packages are designed specifically to support impoverished grassroots households.
items.zh_ex: 財政援助方案專為支援貧困基層家庭而設計。

items.en_ex: Law enforcers cracked down on illegal bid rigging in residential maintenance projects.
items.zh_ex: 執法人員嚴厲打擊住宅維修工程中的非法圍標行為。

items.en_ex: Police neutralized a criminal syndicate that manipulated municipal housing refurbishment contracts.
items.zh_ex: 警方瓦解了一個操縱市區樓宇翻新合約的犯罪集團。

items.en_ex: Authorities successfully dismantled an illicit network involved in commercial fraud and bribery.
items.zh_ex: 當局成功瓦解了一個涉及商業詐騙及受賄的非法網絡。

items.en_ex: Multiple suspects faced severe criminal charges including documentation forgery and conspiracy to defraud.
items.zh_ex: 多名嫌疑人面臨包括偽造文件和串謀詐騙在內的嚴重刑事指控。

items.en_ex: Corporate directors were formally convicted of conspiracy to defraud over inflated public tenders.
items.zh_ex: 企業董事因涉及虛報投標金額的串謀詐騙罪而被正式定罪。

items.en_ex: Security officials established a temporary no-fly zone across the downtown district during the summit.
items.zh_ex: 保安官員在峰會期間於市中心區域設立了臨時禁飛區。

items.en_ex: Police forces must closely liaise with urban planners to minimize transit disruptions.
items.zh_ex: 警隊必須與城市規劃部門緊密協調，以盡量減少交通中斷。

items.en_ex: Heavy congestion is anticipated in the vicinity of the exhibition convention center.
items.zh_ex: 會展中心周邊預計將會出現嚴重交通擁擠。

items.en_ex: The global law enforcement body convenes annually to negotiate cross-border crime intelligence.
items.zh_ex: 該全球執法機構每年召開會議，商討跨國犯罪情報。

items.en_ex: The audit committee scrutinized internal records to verify corporate compliance with international export rules.
items.zh_ex: 審計委員會審查內部紀錄，以核實企業對國際出口法規的合規情況。

items.en_ex: Tech conglomerates face growing regulatory scrutiny regarding their overseas trading operations.
items.zh_ex: 科技巨頭在海外貿易運作上面臨日益嚴格的監管審查。

items.en_ex: Startling revelations about executive relationships sent shockwaves throughout the semiconductor industry.
items.zh_ex: 有關高管關係的驚人披露在半導體產業引發震動。

items.en_ex: Government analysts have cast doubt on initial media reports regarding covert espionage activities.
items.zh_ex: 政府分析人士對媒體最初有關秘密間諜活動的報導提出了質疑。

items.en_ex: Diplomatic ties worsened significantly following allegations of state-sponsored economic espionage.
items.zh_ex: 在出現國家級經濟間諜活動的指控後，外交關係顯著惡化。

items.en_ex: Federal authorities opened investigations into clandestine attempts to smuggle microchips across borders.
items.zh_ex: 聯邦機構對企圖跨界走私微晶片的秘密行動展開了調查。

items.en_ex: It behooves senior leaders to act transparently when public confidence begins to erode.
items.zh_ex: 當公眾信心開始動搖時，高層領導人理應採取透明的行動。

items.en_ex: Regulators demanded a fulsome and coherent response to clarify suspected regulatory discrepancies.
items.zh_ex: 監管機構要求給出詳盡且連貫的答覆，以澄清涉嫌違規之處。

items.zh: 責任由誰承擔；終極責任歸屬
items.en_ex: Independent investigators must determine where the buck stops regarding systemic supply chain compliance errors.
items.zh_ex: 獨立調查人員必須查明供應鏈系統性合規錯誤的最終責任歸屬。

items.en_ex: The board decided to leave the door open for the departed executive to return.
items.zh_ex: 董事會決定為該名離任高層的回歸保留餘地。

items.en_ex: Automated aviation software began to malfunction, creating extensive operational backlogs across international terminals.
items.zh_ex: 自動化航空軟體開始發生故障，在各國際客運大樓造成大面積的作業積壓。

items.en_ex: Aviation agencies issued a ground stop after computerized weight calculation systems crashed.
items.zh_ex: 電腦化重量計算系統崩潰後，航空機構發布了地面停飛管制令。

items.en_ex: Technicians deployed a manual workaround to safely expedite passenger departures without computer guidance.
items.zh_ex: 技術人員採用了手動權宜措施，以便在沒有電腦指引的情況下安全加速旅客出發。

items.en_ex: Multilateral diplomatic talks fizzled out without establishing concrete emission reduction targets.
items.zh_ex: 多邊外交會談草草收場，未能確立具體的減排目標。

items.en_ex: Nations struggled to establish an overarching treaty capable of addressing catastrophic environmental shifts.
items.zh_ex: 各國難以達成一項能夠應對災難性環境變化的總體條約。

items.en_ex: The collapse of ministerial climate negotiations represents a disappointing setback for global governance.
items.zh_ex: 部長級氣候談判的破裂代表了全球治理中令人失望的挫折。

items.en_ex: Environmental advocates lamented the lack of political willpower displayed by industrialized states.
items.zh_ex: 環保倡議者對工業化國家所展現的政治意願不足深感遺憾。

items.en_ex: Abrupt fuel supply restrictions frequently trigger drastic price volatility throughout international energy markets.
items.zh_ex: 突然的燃料供應限制往往會在國際能源市場引發劇烈的價格波動。

items.en_ex: It is unconscionable to endorse a treaty that ignores the perilous consequences of fossil fuels.
items.zh_ex: 簽署一項漠視化石燃料危險後果的條約是泯滅良心的。

items.en_ex: Advanced carbon capture and storage technologies are heavily contested among climate experts and industry lobbyists.
items.zh_ex: 先進的碳捕集與封存技術在氣候專家和行業說客之間引起了激烈爭論。

items.en_ex: The proposal encountered fierce pushback from climate activists who favored direct emission cuts.
items.zh_ex: 該提議遭到了主張直接減少排放的氣候活動家們的強烈反對。

items.en_ex: Diplomats maintained unyielding red lines on the issue of external sovereign debt exemptions.
items.zh_ex: 外交官在外債豁免問題上堅守著不可退讓的底線。

items.zh: 挺身而出承擔重任；及時應對挑戰
items.en_ex: Global authorities must rise to the moment to curb climate warming before catastrophe unfolds.
items.zh_ex: 全球領導當局必須及時承擔重任，在災難爆發前抑制氣候變暖。

items.en_ex: The defense attorney will thoroughly cross-examine the prosecution witness during upcoming courtroom proceedings.
items.zh_ex: 辯方律師將在接下來的庭審程序中深入盤問控方證人。

items.en_ex: The defendant insisted that previous verbal disputes were merely innocent banter between close acquaintances.
items.zh_ex: 被告堅持聲稱先前的言語爭執只不過是熟人之間善意的玩笑打趣。

items.en_ex: Contradictory witness statements threaten to undermine the overall credibility of the defense case.
items.zh_ex: 互相矛盾的證人陳詞恐將削弱辯方申辯的整體公信力。

items.en_ex: Prosecutors argued that the accused attempted to fabricate deceptive evidence to divert suspicion.
items.zh_ex: 控方指稱被告企圖捏造誤導性證據以轉移嫌疑。

items.en_ex: Liaison officials tout record voting turnout as a demonstration of high-quality local governance.
items.zh_ex: 聯絡官員盛讚創紀錄的投票率，指其充分展現了優質的地方治理。

items.en_ex: Legislative leaders worked together to overhaul electoral procedures to ensure greater national administrative stability.
items.zh_ex: 立法機關負責人通力合作全面改革選舉程序，以確保國家行政的更大穩定。

items.en_ex: The foreign astronaut was trained extensively to operate scientific apparatus as a payload specialist.
items.zh_ex: 外籍太空人接受了廣泛訓練，以有效載荷專家的身分操作科學儀器。

items.en_ex: Aerospace partnerships help diverse ethnic minorities to integrate more closely into wider domestic society.
items.zh_ex: 航天合作有助於不同的少數族裔更緊密地融入更廣泛的本土社會。

items.en_ex: Organizers will review public sentiment before deciding whether to roll out the financial incentive scheme.
items.zh_ex: 主辦方在決定是否正式推行該項財務激勵機制前，將檢視公眾反應。
